first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The crew-cut man on the image-left, with a relatively slim build, wearing a dark zip-up jacket and dark trousers.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The man on the image-right wearing a dark close-fitting knit cap, a loose dark leather jacket, a light-colored high-neck sweatshirt, and light-colored trousers.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The man in the central foreground wearing a dark pom-pom hat, a thick dark coat, a light-colored hooded inner layer, and camouflage trousers; the coat hem has a light-colored edge.

entities.name: multistory buildings along the street
entities.identification: The cluster of multistory buildings on both sides of the road and in the distant background; rows of windows and horizontal floor structures are discernible on the out-of-focus facades.

entities.name: city road
entities.identification: The city street below and behind the railing, converging toward the central distant background.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The light-gray area of sky between and above the buildings.

entities.name: group of road vehicles
entities.identification: The distant group of traffic in the depth of the central road, appearing as blurred gray forms and bright spots from vehicle lights.

entities.name: dark metal railing
entities.identification: The horizontal dark top rail, spaced vertical posts, and bottom connector bases behind the people.

entities.name: stone parapet
entities.identification: The horizontal parapet below the railing, with a wide dark band on top and a mottled light-gray wall surface below.

entities.name: streetlights along the street
entities.identification: The streetlight in the image-left background, with a horizontal wide lamp head and part of its support pole visible.
